ITEM 1 | Roasted carrot slices, orange with darker caramelized edges and char spots on some rounds, glossy with slight oil sheen, firm and holding shape, roughly 1 cm thick rounds of about 3-4 cm diameter, piled in a cluster covering roughly 20% of the plate's right side | 110

ITEM 2 | Creamy, pale off-white mixed mound with flecks of green herbs and small pale pieces, possibly soft and moist with a grainy, crumbly texture, about 6 cm by 5 cm footprint and roughly 1.5 cm tall, sitting at the upper right edge of the plate beside the carrots | 85

ITEM 3 | Scattered dark green wilted leaves with thin stems, flat and glossy, mixed into and along the edge of the pale mound, covering about 3 cm by 2 cm total | 8
